A pickup truck crashed into a ditch near Applebee's along Bob Bullock Loop in Laredo early Saturday morning, November 8, 2026.

Laredo Police Department officers were at the scene after the crash was reported around midnight. The pickup ended up in a ditch off the roadway near the restaurant.

Light rain and drizzle were being reported across Laredo at the time, leaving roads potentially slick for drivers.

What caused the crash remains unclear, and no injuries have been reported.

Drivers traveling through the area are advised to use caution while officers work the scene.

Source: On-scene reports.
